C0166.title: Global Largest Game Cheat Case Cracked: Amount Involved Reaches Hundreds of Millions of Yuan
C0166.summary: In March 2021, Kunshan police cracked the world's largest game cheat case with illicit flow reaching hundreds of millions of yuan, dismantling 17 cheat trading and card-distribution platforms across six provinces and nine cities. The cheat, known as 'Chicken Leg', targeted Peacekeeper Elite and provided features such as auto-aim and wallhacks, severely disrupting game balance. In January 2021, police successively arrested the global finance head surnamed Wang and the global operations head surnamed He.
